# Function isGemini2OrAbove

  * isGemini2OrAbove(modelString: string): boolean

Check if the model is a Gemini 2.x model using regex patterns.

#### Parameters

    * modelString: string

Either a simple model name or path - based model name

#### Returns boolean

true if it's a Gemini 2.x model, false otherwise.
